meta.name: esm
meta.description: Use when working directly with the `esm` Python SDK, ESM3 or ESMC model IDs, Forge/Biohub inference clients, or ESMFold2 folding workflows.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 运行 ESM 模型进行蛋白质结构预测与推理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要预测蛋白质结构或运行 ESM 模型推理。
copy.tagline_en: Predict protein structures and run ESM model inference
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to predict protein structures or run ESM model inference.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能用 Python 处理蛋白质计算任务,比如生成或补全蛋白序列、预测结构、计算嵌入(特征),并会写出可运行的代码、选对模型。
howto.when: 当你要做蛋白质序列生成/补全、结构预测、嵌入计算等任务,或提到 ESM3、ESMC、Forge/Biohub 时,就会启用。

say.text: 用 ESM3 把序列 MPRT___KEND 中缺失的氨基酸补全。
say.note: Claude 会写出补全序列的 Python 代码。

say.text: 根据这个 PDB 文件,设计一条能折叠成该结构的蛋白质序列。
say.note: Claude 会调用反向折叠功能生成序列。

say.text: 用 ESMC 计算这三条蛋白质序列的嵌入向量。
say.note: Claude 会输出嵌入计算的代码和结果。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can write Python code for protein tasks using the official ESM SDK: generating or completing sequences, predicting structures, computing embeddings, and picking the right model or API.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to generate or complete protein sequences, predict structures, compute embeddings, or mentions ESM3, ESMC, Forge/Biohub, or ESMFold2.

say_en.text: Use ESM3 to complete the missing amino acids in sequence MPRT___KEND.
say_en.note: Claude will provide code to fill the masked positions.

say_en.text: Use this PDB file to design a protein sequence that folds into that structure.
say_en.note: Claude will run inverse folding to generate the sequence.

say_en.text: Use ESMC to compute embeddings for these three protein sequences.
say_en.note: Claude will output embedding code and results.
